0022600222.text: The Lakers (10-2, first in the Pacific and the West) come in on a six-game winning streak and a 5-1 road record, while the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East) are on a six-game losing streak and sit six games back in the Central. Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision for the Lakers, and Tyler Herro is out for Milwaukee with a knee bruise. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the most recent game a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
